name: scrapegrapghai
label: ScrapeGraphAI
description: AI-powered web scraping and content extraction.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your ScrapeGraphAI API Key:

1. Visit [ScrapeGraphAI](https://scrapegraphai.com) and create an account.
2. Log in and navigate to your dashboard.
3. Locate and copy your API key from the dashboard.

smart_scraper.label: Smart Scraper
smart_scraper.description: Extract content from a webpage using AI by providing a natural language prompt.

user_prompt.label: Extraction Prompt
user_prompt.description: Describe what information you want to extract in natural language.

output_schema.label: Output Schema
output_schema.description: Optional schema to structure the output data.

local_scraper.label: Local Scraper
local_scraper.description: Extract content from HTML content using AI by providing a natural language prompt.

user_prompt.label: Extraction Prompt
user_prompt.description: Describe what information you want to extract in natural language.

output_schema.label: Output Schema
output_schema.description: Optional schema to structure the output data.

markdownify.label: Convert to Markdown
markdownify.description: Convert any webpage into clean, readable Markdown format.

website_url.label: Website URL
website_url.description: The webpage URL to convert to Markdown

scrapegrapghai_extract_data.label: Extract Data
scrapegrapghai_extract_data.description: Extracts structured data from a URL, HTML or markdown using a natural-language prompt.

url.label: URL
url.description: Public page URL to fetch and extract from. Provide exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.

html.label: HTML
html.description: Raw HTML to extract from (max 2 MB). Provide exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: Markdown text to extract from (max 2 MB). Provide exactly one of URL, HTML or Markdown.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural-language description of what to extract, e.g. "the product name and price".

schema.label: Schema
schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object the output must match.

mode.label: HTML Mode
mode.description: Pre-processing of the source: normal, reader (main article only) or prune (strip boilerplate). Defaults to normal.

fetchConfig.label: Fetch Config
fetchConfig.description: Optional fetch options object: mode ("auto" default, "fast" or "js"), stealth (true for residential proxy, +5 credits), headers (object), cookies (object), scrolls (0-100), wait (ms after load, 0-30000), timeout (ms, 1000-60000), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), e.g. {"mode":"js","wait":2000}.

scrapegrapghai_search_web.label: Search the Web
scrapegrapghai_search_web.description: Runs a web search and returns the top results with their page content.

numResults.label: Number of Results
numResults.description: How many results to fetch, 1-20. Defaults to 3.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional extraction prompt run across all fetched results; the answer is returned under `json`.

schema.label: Schema
schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object for the extraction output. Requires Prompt.

format.label: Content Format
format.description: Format of each result's inline content. Defaults to markdown.

timeRange.label: Time Range
timeRange.description: Only return results published within this window. Defaults to any time.

locationGeoCode.label: Country
locationGeoCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for localized results, e.g. "us" or "it".

fetchConfig.label: Fetch Config
fetchConfig.description: Optional fetch options object: mode ("auto" default, "fast" or "js"), stealth (true for residential proxy, +5 credits), headers (object), cookies (object), scrolls (0-100), wait (ms after load, 0-30000), timeout (ms, 1000-60000), country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), e.g. {"mode":"js","wait":2000}.

scrapegrapghai_get_crawl.description: Gets the status and progress of a crawl job.

crawlId.description: Crawl job UUID, returned as `id` by Start Crawl.

cursor.label: Cursor

scrapegrapghai_delete_crawl.description: Permanently deletes a crawl job and its stored pages.

crawlId.label: Crawl ID
crawlId.description: Crawl job UUID, returned as `id` by Start Crawl.

monitorId.label: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.

scrapegrapghai_pause_monitor.description: Pauses a monitor so it stops running.

monitorId.label: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.

monitorId.label: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.

scrapegrapghai_delete_monitor.description: Permanently deletes a monitor and its run history.

monitorId.label: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.

scrapegrapghai_list_monitor_activity.label: List Monitor Activity
scrapegrapghai_list_monitor_activity.description: Lists a monitor's recent runs with change flags.

monitorId.label: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Monitor UUID, returned as `cronId` by Create Monitor or List Monitors.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.description: The `nextCursor` timestamp from the previous call, to fetch older runs.

scrapegrapghai_list_history.label: List History
scrapegrapghai_list_history.description: Lists past API requests, newest first.

service.label: Service
service.description: Only return requests from this service. Defaults to all.

sessionId.label: Session ID
sessionId.description: Only return requests whose session ID contains this text (case-insensitive).

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

scrapegrapghai_get_history_entry.label: Get History Entry
scrapegrapghai_get_history_entry.description: Gets one past request and its full result by ID.

requestId.label: Request ID
requestId.description: UUID of the request: `id` from Scrape Page, Extract Data or Search the Web, `scrapeRefId` from Get Crawl, or a run `id` from List Monitor Activity.

scrapegrapghai_get_credits.label: Get Credits
scrapegrapghai_get_credits.description: Gets the remaining credit balance, plan and job quotas.
